export_format: PyTorch checkpoint downloaded from Hugging Face at runtime; ONNX not supplied or validated
upstream_revision: main (not pinned; pin a commit SHA for production deployments)
input_dimensions: dynamic source image, divided into 1024 px tiles with 128 px overlap by default
class_ids: Loaded from the checkpoint configuration at runtime
normalization: Hugging Face image processor defaults for the selected checkpoint

preprocessing.cropping: none; complete page covered by overlapping tiles

coordinate_conventions: origin at top-left; x increases right; y increases down; polygon points [x,y]; bbox [x,y,width,height]; coordinates refer to full rendered/oriented input page pixels

devices: cuda when compatible PyTorch and driver are installed
runtime.fallback: auto selects CUDA when available and otherwise CPU

license: Upstream model is labeled 'other'; inspect upstream model card and dataset terms before use or redistribution. We do not redistribute model weights.
model_file_checksums: No weights are bundled; runtime fetches upstream weights. Pin and hash the downloaded files before production release.
